reference: F. Najman, Isolated and sporadic points on X_1(N) and X_0(N) (2026), https://hexagonmath.org/2611.00884v1, Proposition 6.2 (the coordinates are in x1-isolated/points/point24.txt of github.com/F-Najman/isolated_sporadic at revision 88bc530)
notes: Converted to Tate normal form from the point on Sutherland's alternative model of X_1(24) in the proof of Proposition 6.2 of the paper, where l(x) = 1 is proved; J_1(24)(Q) is finite, so the point is isolated. It is not sporadic: X_1(24) has gonality smaller than 5.
